title: Swap Halves of Phone Number

content.problemStatement: Given a mobile number swap it without the country code. Split the phone number into two half without the country code and form the new mobile number such that the second half of the phone number should be the first part and first part of the phone number should be second part.
content.outputFormat: Print the newly formed phone number

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Strip country code '91' if 12 digits, then split into two 5-digit halves and swap.
solution.editorial: If length is 12 and starts with '91', take last 10 digits. Print s[5:] + s[:5].

hints: Print last 5 digits followed by first 5 digits.
